notes.title: Update 1.1 - Released
notes.content:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/34552531/c46b2d8d2b3aa10ab04f5d6d8fa1a035abc773a6.png[/img]

Hello!

Here it is, update 1.1

I hope you all enjoy the new content, i added this bit of extra content due to recent feedback.

Virtual Girlfriend in-game game is now available, along with a new gallery once you unlock it, with two additional achievements. Adding additional achievements is not something i continually plan to do as i understand how having to go back and replay a game you already got 100% on could be bothersome. 

Any feedback regarding this is appreciated.

As before, you will need to make sure your mum doesn't catch you, I also advise you make sure that your actual mum also doesn't walk in!

Along with this content update, the UI as been tweaked and a few minor bugs have been fixed. The "MUM CAM" as been slightly changed to simulate someone actually walking around, adding motion to the camera.

Your opinion on the new content is also appreciated, don't like it? or would like to see more new content like this?

If you run into any problems, please do let me know.
